title: Kesh's Tally
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Kesh the Red's raiders took Fred Skentz's strongbox, and his ledger with it. Hal Rourke saw them go from the watchtower.

About

Given byHal Rourke
Level24
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Freds Strongbox ×1

Steps

  1. Talk to Hal Rourke to get the quest.
  2. Kill Kesh the Red at 725, 438
    Bring Fred Skentz his strongbox - Freds Strongbox at 568, 681
  3. Give Fred Skentz your answer at 570, 683
  4. Talk to the Skentz post quartermaster at 572, 648

Rewards

Reward
Gold2,500
Character XP78,000
Quest points1

What Hal Rourke says

Fred Skentz: My box. The lock's broken, but the ledger's still in it.

Fred Skentz: Hang on. These last pages aren't in my hand. Somebody has kept a tally in my own book: my crates, my scrap, all sold on at Varra Sunstrike's warcamp on the salt road.

Fred Skentz: So that's where my goods go. Kesh takes them, Varra sells them, and they split the coin.

Fred Skentz: The Bloomguard would want to see this. Then again, it's my ledger, and I don't hand my books to soldiers. What do you think?

You: Kesh's raiders sold Fred's goods through Varra Sunstrike's warcamp. It's all in his ledger.

Bloomguard Quartermaster: Varra's camp sits right on the salt road to Agauton. If she's buying from Kesh, she's buying from every raider on the flats.

Bloomguard Quartermaster: I'll send word to the Agauton post. They'll want to watch that road.

Bloomguard Quartermaster: With Kesh gone, the raiders will think twice about coming this far west. Take this. Fred put in his share.

Handing it in
